title: Endosymbiosis — rich

pieces.file: Endosymbiosis — rich — two rhythms become one.m4a
pieces.title: Two rhythms become one
pieces.caption: Two tones seven hertz apart, beating against each other. From four seconds the coupling between them rises: the beat slows, lurches, and near nine seconds they lock onto one pitch that neither started on. Each keeps its own timbre to the end, hollow in the left ear and round in the right. *What is real and what is a choice:* A two-oscillator Kuramoto model, the page's own image. It is not a model of a cell.
